title: Design System: Nick Wilsan — Product Management Portfolio

display.purpose: The hero claim only; one per page (The Display-Once Rule).

body.purpose: All paragraph copy, always set in Muted.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, hero-fact labels, browser-chrome status text.

shadows.name: artifact
shadows.purpose: The case-study browser-chrome mockup only; implies a lifted physical object.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: MaskReveal entrances — text rising from behind a clip.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Fade/slide-up entrances for paragraphs and hero facts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA, e.g. "See the work". Ink fill, fully rounded, shifts to Moss Green on hover.
components.html: See the work
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #121210; color: #f6f6f3; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #2f7a4e; } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-icon { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action, e.g. "Get in touch". Underline only, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-size: 14px; color: #121210; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e0d8; padding-bottom: 2px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #2f7a4e; }

components.name: Filter Tag — Active
components.description: Selected filter pill in the Work section.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tag-active { background: #e2f0e8; color: #235e3b; }

components.name: Filter Tag — Inactive
components.description: Unselected filter pill in the Work section.

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <textarea class="ds-input" placeholder="Tell me about the role..."></textarea>
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e0d8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; color: #121210; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a887f; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2f7a4e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2f7a4e; }

components.name: Artifact Card
components.description: Browser-chrome mockup framing a case-study screenshot.
components.css: .ds-artifact { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e0d8; background: #ffffff; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -26px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-artifact-chrome { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e0d8; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e2e0d8; } .ds-artifact-body { padding: 24px; color: #8a887f; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
This site is built to read like a case file, not a pitch deck: every claim about Nick's process is followed immediately by the artifact that backs it up — a case study, a prioritization call, a piece of written requirements. The design exists to get out of the way of that evidence, not to perform confidence on its behalf.

The palette is near-monochrome paper-and-ink with a single moss-green accent held in reserve, the typography pairs an unhurried serif display against a clean grotesque body, and motion is restrained — entrances that settle the page in, not choreography that competes with the reading. Nothing here should look like it was assembled from a SaaS landing-page kit: no gradient hero text, no uniform icon-grid feature cards, no bento boxes.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink neutrals with one disciplined accent, never decorative.
Newsreader serif for display moments, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything functional.
Flat surfaces; shadow reserved for one signature artifact (the browser-chrome case-study mockup).
Quiet, settling motion (mask reveals, gentle parallax) — never scroll-jacking choreography.

rules.name: The Rare Green Rule
rules.body: Moss green never fills a surface; it marks a single point of attention per view (one CTA, one active tag, one emphasized word). If green is touching more than ~10% of any screen, pull it back.

rules.name: The Display-Once Rule
rules.body: The largest display size appears exactly once per page, in the hero. Every other heading steps down at least one tier so the hero claim keeps its weight.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Exactly one shadow value exists in the system, reserved for the case-study artifact. Buttons, tags, inputs, and nav stay flat with borders or fills, never shadows.

dos: Do keep Moss Green to a single point of attention per view (CTA hover, one active tag, one emphasis word).
Do pair every process claim with a concrete artifact or number.
Do use the Paper/Surface background swap and Line hairlines for section rhythm instead of cards or shadows.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every reveal, parallax, or count-up animation.
donts: Don't introduce gradient hero text, uniform icon-grid feature cards, or bento-box layouts.
Don't add a second saturated color.
Don't add shadows to buttons, tags, inputs, or nav.
Don't use a face photo anywhere in the system.
Don't stack a tiny uppercase eyebrow above every section on top of the existing numbered section heads.
